profile.headline: Crafting innovative web experiences with TypeScript & React expertise.
profile.summary:
As a self-taught web developer, I have honed my TypeScript and React skills through hands-on
experience and a relentless pursuit of knowledge. With a passion for creating elegant and functional
websites, I am driven to deliver innovative solutions that enhance user experiences and push the
boundaries of web development.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Developed websites for multiple clients, including Law firms, sports organizations, and more
with Next.js, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL.
o Increased company revenue on average by 23%
o Increased company site traffic on average by 68%
o Increased site traffic on personal site by 113%
• For examples of my work, please visit https://www.jpswebdesign.dev/

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Designed and developed a ticketing system for Par Pacific’s retail gas stations, allowing on-site employees to submit detailed work orders for repair and maintenance issues, using MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, and Node.js

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Developed and maintained a real time, auction-based application for selling Oil & Gas items, leveraging Next.js for the frontend and PHP for the backend.
Designed and developed an auction-based application for selling Oil & Gas items, supporting $10M+ in transactions, using Next.js for the frontend and PHP for the backend.
Optimized application performance to handle 3,500+ users monthly, ensuring seamless bidding and transaction processes.
Improved backend efficiency, resulting in 30% faster transaction processing times, enhancing the overall user experience.
Implemented robust security measures to protect sensitive user and transaction data, ensuring compliance with industry standards.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Developed an Internal Use Application using React, TypeScript, and Node.js, streamlining order
automation, data, commission management, component tracking, testing information, and delinquent account monitoring.
o Streamlined order processing, resulting in a remarkable 70% increase in order processing speed. o Implemented effective strategies for delinquent payment recovery, leading to a substantial $75,000
(40%) improvement in collections.
o By automating various processes, which successfully reduced the need for manual data entry by
an impressive 90%, freeing up valuable time for employees to focus on strategic tasks.
o Application was used by several departments, averaging 40 users per day in a 50 person company.
● Developed a Real-time Sales Trends Visualization Application using Next.js, TypeScript, and Chart.js, designed to provide real-time insights into current sales trends, which offered key stakeholders, potential investors, partners, and clients a visually compelling and easily accessible overview of sales performance.
o As a result of implementing this display, we achieved remarkable cost savings, amounting to $10,000 in commission that would have otherwise been paid to a third-party contractor for generating similar reports.
o Ensured the application's seamless performance and data visualization capabilities, empowering decision-makers with accurate and up-to-date information for strategic planning.
o The Sales Growth Display garnered positive feedback from both internal and external stakeholders, enabling the organization to make data-driven decisions promptly and optimize sales strategies effectively.
● Maintained and updated the company website, ensuring it was up-to-date with the latest content and security patches.
o Improved website performance, resulting in a 25% increase in page load speed.
o Implemented SEO best practices, boosting organic traffic by 30%.
o Coordinated with the marketing team to implement new features and promotional content.
